caption: Shepherd villages gather on the Palatine hill above the marshes of the Tiber.
The kings are driven out, and a great temple to Jupiter crowns the Capitol.
Conquest pours wealth into the city. Crowded apartment blocks climb the hills.
In AD 64 a great fire burns for six days, and the centre is rebuilt in stone.
A million people. The Colosseum, the Pantheon and Trajan's Forum rise in marble.
title: THE ETERNAL CITY

caption: As invaders threaten, Aurelian rings the whole city with new walls.
Sieges and plague empty the city, and the aqueducts are cut.
Cattle graze in the old Forum. The city shrinks into the bend of the Tiber.
title: THE DARK AGES

caption: The popes come home to a half-empty city.
New Saint Peter's is consecrated, and fountains and piazzas remake the city.
Rome becomes the capital of a united Italy.
After the war, the city spreads far beyond its ancient walls.
Almost three million people now live in the Eternal City.
